conventions.convention: Category descriptors always carry intent. Root Unleash may omit customCategory.
Category eligibility must not be stricter than its children.
Child actions map every Papyrus parameter; empty static when Papyrus detects at runtime.
In-game SKSE must be Release. Debug /MDd breaks SkyrimNet decorator ABI. CRT stays /MD (x64-windows-static-md).
ESP source of truth is Spriggit/SkyrimNet_Leashed/, not a hand-edited .esp.
Do not vendor or recompile LeashFramework.psc; call the runtime natives.
Wrists is chain only (Leash_hand_chain 0xD69). KindForBodyPart and PrismaUI lockWristType force type to chain.
